title: config/release.json
description: The packages, manifests and Go modules that a release tag covers, read by scripts/kit/release.mjs.

repositoryUrl.description: The URL of the repository; the notes of a release that is too long link CHANGELOG.md below it.

changelog.description: The change log whose section `## X.Y.Z` is the notes of the release.

changelogTranslations.description: Further change logs that must hold the section `## X.Y.Z`.

checks.description: The check runs of the tagged commit that must have concluded success; push-gate and ci-passed when absent.

packages.description: The packages that a tag vX.Y.Z releases as one archive each.

manifests.description: Each manifest whose version a tag vX.Y.Z sets, with how the tag releases it: archive, version or git-tag.

notReleased.description: Each tracked manifest that no tag releases, with the reason.

goModules.description: Each Go module by its directory (`.` for the repository root) with its module path.

consumers.description: The consumer projects that install the archives of a tag outside the repository (release-consumer.mjs); one per package kind that has packages.

directory.description: The directory of the committed manifest and lock of the consumer project.

smoke.description: Each package that the consumer installs, with the command (an array of strings) that checks it in the installed project.

directory.description: The directory of the committed manifest and lock of the consumer project.

smoke.description: Each package that the consumer installs, with the command (an array of strings) that checks it in the installed project.

proof.description: What the release proof (release-proof.mjs) installs from the tag besides the archives.

gitTag.description: Each manifest with the mode git-tag, with { kind: python|rust, name, smoke } for its install from the tag.
